# MarketToSkills - Universal AI Agent Skills Registry

> Standardized repository containing 3,200+ specialized skills for AI coding agents.
> Compatible with Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot.

## Agent Usage Instructions

To load and apply any skill in your active context:
1. Inspect `skills/catalog.json` for fast keyword/semantic filtering.
2. Read the skill's instructions: `view_file` on `skills/<category>/<skill-id>/SKILL.md`.
3. Follow the instructions and execute any helper scripts in `skills/<category>/<skill-id>/scripts/`.
